observations: Photo 0 shows a manual pallet jack with a yellow/brown fork frame and black handle.
The forks and wheels are visible; no clear label/plate with capacity is readable in the photo.
No close-up of the hydraulic pump, release valve, or any model/serial plate.
No photo of lifting height, load test, or underside condition.

claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable capacity plate/model/serial number to confirm 2.5 ton or hydraulic specs.

risks.risk: Capacity may be less than claimed (e.g., not actually 2.5 ton).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the capacity rating plate/sticker on the jack (with the number clearly readable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic manual pallet jack with unknown/possibly lower capacity.

risks.risk: Hydraulics may be weak/leaking (won’t lift fully or won’t hold load).
risks.proof: Video clip showing: pump to full lift, hold for 1–2 minutes with no load drop, and smooth lowering.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to lift/hold properly (worst-case working uncertainty).

risks.risk: Forks/wheels may be worn or damaged (uneven lift, rough steering, bad rollers).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of fork tips and wheel/roller condition (including any cracks, flat spots, or bent forks).

risks.risk: Manual release/valve may be faulty (stuck lowering or jerky operation).
risks.proof: Short video of lowering from full height repeatedly and smoothly using the release lever.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity plate/sticker (showing the tonnage clearly).
Video: lift to maximum height, hold for 1–2 minutes (no noticeable drop), then lower smoothly.
Close-up photos of fork tips and all rollers/wheels (front and rear).
Photo of the hydraulic pump area/release valve for leaks or damage.
response.reason: The item type is visible (manual pallet jack), but the key pricing driver—confirmed 2.5 ton capacity and working hydraulic performance—cannot be verified from the single photo. To price safely for Abuja pickup demand, request the capacity plate and a lift/hold test video.
